findings.title: Findings converge on the "accurate path always replaces" write rule
findings.why_it_matters: Two writers feed the accurate-path rule from different sources; Findings 6 and 7 are the same question about which accurate path wins.
findings.recommended: A: Re-evaluate the "accurate path always replaces" rule before addressing Findings 6 and 7 individually
findings.chosen: A: Re-evaluate the "accurate path always replaces" rule before addressing Findings 6 and 7 individually
findings.choice_reason: Re-evaluation adopted as ledger D4: top-level session transcripts only, last writer wins, residual resumed-pre-move drift accepted.

findings.title: D3's per-project handler swallows infrastructure failures and does not say it rolls back
findings.why_it_matters: A catch-all reverses import_project's deliberate OperationalError abort, and without rollback the next project joins the failed project's transaction.
findings.recommended: A: Amend D3: the handler catches non-OperationalError exceptions; OperationalError rolls back and propagates
findings.chosen: A: Amend D3: the handler catches non-OperationalError exceptions; OperationalError rolls back and propagates

findings.title: Contained project failures have no reader in the detached run
findings.why_it_matters: The background import runs on most SessionStarts with output to DEVNULL; exit code and summary have no consumer there.
findings.recommended: A: Amend D3 to say the exit code and summary serve interactive runs only
findings.chosen: A: Amend D3 to say the exit code and summary serve interactive runs only

findings.title: The probe parses whole transcripts; walk-back unbounded and unspecified on failure
findings.why_it_matters: Full materialization of the newest (largest) transcript per project on every import; no-cwd dirs parse every file.
findings.recommended: A: Specify that the probe streams lines and stops at the first entry with a cwd
findings.chosen: A: Specify that the probe streams lines and stops at the first entry with a cwd

findings.title: The insert's conflict clause is unspecified
findings.why_it_matters: Copying the current DO UPDATE clause onto key would let a losing lossy insert overwrite an accurate name.
findings.recommended: A: Specify INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(key) DO NOTHING followed by the existing SELECT by key
findings.chosen: A: Specify INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(key) DO NOTHING followed by the existing SELECT by key

findings.title: The stored path and name drift between the two writers
findings.why_it_matters: path/name and the INFO log alternate with the last writer, shifting --project filter results.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation

findings.title: The probe's candidate set includes subagent transcripts, ordered by mtime
findings.why_it_matters: A subagent's subdirectory cwd changes name and can bypass exclude_projects.
findings.recommended: A: Restrict the probe to top-level session transcripts

findings.title: The rebuild sequence and FK target are not pinned
findings.why_it_matters: Renaming projects away would silently repoint sessions.project_id on SQLite 3.26+.
findings.recommended: A: Specify the order and add matrix assertions on the sessions FK target
findings.chosen: A: Specify the order and add matrix assertions on the sessions FK target
findings.choice_reason: Asked about the runtime foreign_key_check's benefit; a before/after comparison variant was offered; chose tests-only since the bug class is deterministic and the real DB has 0 violations.

findings.title: The fresh-install path through v9 is untested
findings.why_it_matters: A fresh DB gets the new shape from SCHEMA_CORE and is then rebuilt by v9; no test pins it.
findings.chosen: Add a fresh-install case to the Assumed test list: user_version 9, no UNIQUE index on path, idx_projects_key present, duplicate paths insert.

findings.title: Exclusion is checked after the probe and the row write
findings.why_it_matters: An excluded project's transcripts are read and its row persisted on every import.
findings.recommended: A: Leave the order as is in this change, and file an issue to revisit exclusion order
findings.chosen: A: Leave the order as is in this change, and file an issue to revisit exclusion order

findings.title: Older ccrecall against a v9 database fails on new-project inserts
findings.why_it_matters: Pre-v9 ON CONFLICT(path) matches no constraint after v9.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation

findings.title: A failed v9 migration makes every command and hook fail on open
findings.why_it_matters: Atomic rollback keeps v8 intact, but every open raises with no friendly message.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation

Writer flip-flop lets an excluded project be imported
